title: Data Investigation
text:
For this project, we will be looking at CDC data about Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART). This data provides information about fertility clinics across the United States in the years 2020-2022. Links to download each year of the data are provided below:

2020 data
2021 data
2022 data

library(tidyverse)

library(ggplot2)
library(usmap)

CDC <- longdata |>
  select(-c("SubTopicId")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = SubTopic, values_from = Data_Value) |>

title: Data Investigation
text:
Data Investigation

One-Way Contingency Tables
Use one-way contingency tables to display the number of clinics that fall within particular groups.

CDC |>
  filter(Year == 2022) |>
  group_by(`Donor egg services`) |>
  summarize(count = n())

# A tibble: 3 × 2
  `Donor egg services` count
  <fct>                <int>
1 No                      53
2 Yes                    404
3 <NA>                    54

CDC |>
  filter(Year == 2022) |>
  group_by(`Clinic Status`) |>
  summarize(count = n())

# A tibble: 4 × 2
  `Clinic Status` count
  <fct>           <int>
1 Closed              5
2 Non-reporter       54
3 Open              422
4 Reorganized        30




Two-Way Contingency Tables
Use two-way contingency tables to display the number of clinics that fall within particular groups.

CDC |>
  filter(Year == 2022) |>
  group_by(`Donor egg services`, `Clinic Status`) |>
  summarize(count = n()) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Clinic Status`, values_from = count)

`summarise()` has regrouped the output.
ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by Donor egg services and Clinic Status.
ℹ Output is grouped by Donor egg services.
ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(Donor egg services, Clinic Status))` for per-operation
  grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.


# A tibble: 3 × 5
# Groups:   Donor egg services [3]
  `Donor egg services` Closed  Open Reorganized `Non-reporter`
  <fct>                 <int> <int>       <int>          <int>
1 No                        2    48           3             NA
2 Yes                       3   374          27             NA
3 <NA>                     NA    NA          NA             54




Numerical Summaries
Numerical summaries (means, medians, sds, etc.) of a quantitative variable at levels of a categorical variable.

CDC |>
  filter(Year == 2022) |>
  group_by(`Gestational carrier services`) |>
  summarize(Sum = sum(`Total infants born`, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Mean (Per Clinic Per Year)` = mean(`Total infants born`, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Median (Per Clinic Per Year)` = median(`Total infants born`, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Standard Deviation (Per Clinic Per Year)` = sd(`Total infants born`, na.rm = TRUE),
            `Inter-Quartile Range (Per Clinic Per Year)` = IQR(`Total infants born`, na.rm = TRUE))

  Gestational carrier serv…¹   Sum Mean (Per Clinic Per…² Median (Per Clinic P…³

Plot 1: Bar Chart

ggplot(data = CDC,
       aes(x = Year, fill = `Gestational carrier services`)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(y = "Number of Clinics") +
  theme_light()










Plot 2: Smoothed Histogram

ggplot(data = CDC |>
         filter(Year == 2022, Pregnancies < 1500) |>
         drop_na(Pregnancies)) +
  geom_density(aes(alpha = 0.5, x = Pregnancies,
                   fill = `Gestational carrier services`)) +
  theme_light()










Plot 3: Box Plot

ggplot(data = CDC |>
         filter(Year == 2022,
                State %in% c("New York",
                                    "California",
                                    "North Carolina")),
       aes(x = State, y = Pregnancies, fill = State)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_light()

Warning: Removed 20 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
(`stat_boxplot()`).











Plot 4: Scatter Plot

ggplot(data = CDC |>
         filter(Year == 2022,
                State %in% c("New York",
                                    "California",
                                    "North Carolina"),
                `Total cycles` < 10000) |>
         drop_na(`Total cycles`, Pregnancies),
       aes(x = `Total cycles`, y = Pregnancies, color = State)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm) + 
  theme_light()

`geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'











Plot 5: Faceted Smooth Histogram

ggplot(data = CDC |>
         filter(Pregnancies < 1500) |>
         drop_na(Pregnancies)) +
  geom_density(aes(alpha = 0.5, x = Pregnancies,
                   fill = `Gestational carrier services`)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Year) +
  theme_light()










Plot 6: Map

plot_usmap(data = CDC |>
             filter(Year == 2022) |>
             drop_na(Pregnancies) |>
             rename(state = State) |>
             group_by(state) |>
             summarize(Pregnancies = sum(Pregnancies)),
           values = "Pregnancies",
           regions = "states") +
  scale_fill_continuous(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Pregnancies")
